ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels occupy approximately 75% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated on the distal 25% of the fluke lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central and medial fluke regions are solid black; distal lobes feature large white contiguous regions; transition boundaries show high-frequency speckling and mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees and a deep vertical penetration into the fluke body.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; distinct peaks and valleys visible against the high-intensity background sky.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch extending to convex distal tips, following a complex sigmoidal curve along the trailing boundary.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of circular, high-contrast anomalies (barnacles) at the lateral-most tips of both lobes; individual white circular spots visible on the dark medial surfaces.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-intensity linear disruptions (rake marks/scratches) on the left lobe, primarily oriented vertically between the peduncle and the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy biological encrustation (barnacle colonization) providing a rough, irregular texture to the leading and trailing edges of the outer lobes.
